$comment: Risk-control → test binding manifest. Created as CAPA-001 action PA-1.
CAPA-001 root cause: 'The verification process accepts unexecuted,
unreproducible, self-attested prose as objective evidence for risk-control
implementation, and nothing in the build pipeline can contradict it.'
This file is the contradiction mechanism. Every risk control whose status is
'implemented' MUST name test node IDs that exist and pass. The manifest is
a named test has disappeared. Deleting a risk control's test therefore turns
CI red instead of producing a silent green build.
implemented  - control exists in code AND is bound to passing tests.
'tests' must be non-empty and every entry must resolve.
not_implemented - control does not exist. Recorded honestly. 'tests' empty.
deliberately_absent - the code intentionally does NOT provide this control;
unverified   - not yet re-verified to the CAPA-001 standard. Must not be
recorded as VERIFIED in the RMF until it is.

RC-006.description: AI-generated report carries a mandatory physician-review disclaimer
RC-006.negative_control: CAPA-001 §5.1 — enforcement line removed: 8 failed, 6 passed

RC-017.description: Authentication required on all API endpoints, including the WebSocket transport
RC-017.note: Covers authentication only. Object-level authorization is absent and is tracked as CAPA-002.

RC-007.description: De-identified data only sent to the third-party model API
RC-007.note: CAPA-001 §2.3 — no de-identification routine exists under backend/app/. Tracked as CAPA-001 CA-4. The RMF must not record this as VERIFIED.

RC-010.rationale: CAPA-001 §2.4 — the geometric classification path sets confidence = None on purpose, because it has no empirically calibrated confidence. Emitting an uncalibrated number would be worse than emitting none. The code is more honest than the documentation was; the RMF row is what must change, not the code.
RC-010.note: Requires a test asserting confidence stays None on the geometric path, so the deliberate absence cannot be 'fixed' by accident. Tracked under CA-3.

RC-022.description: All images preprocessed to MNI 1 mm isotropic space
RC-022.note: CAPA-001 §2.5 — verified only by recollection, which is not objective evidence. The code does not depend on the assumption: it silently defaults voxel_spacing to (1.0, 1.0, 1.0) when metadata is absent, which is the harm HAZ-014 describes. Tracked as CA-5.

RC-001.description: All AI segmentation results labeled assistive / requires physician review
RC-001.note: RCV-2026-07-18 §3.3 — the phrase appears nowhere in the codebase; AI masks are indistinguishable from hand-drawn ones. Tracked as CAPA-001 CA-3.

RC-002.description: Viewing/Edit mode separation; AI results read-only until clinician activates edit
RC-002.implementation: frontend/src/components/ImageViewer2D.tsx (NOT ViewerApp.tsx as the RMF cites)
RC-002.note: Control is real and effective but not bound to a test; UI-layer only, no server-side enforcement. CA-3.

RC-003.description: Manual segmentation tools always available as override
RC-003.note: Rendered only when !is3D && activeSegmentation; in 3D there is no manual override. 'Always' is false. CA-3.

RC-004.description: Volumetry displays percentile ranges with normative reference
RC-004.note: Normative table has no provenance; sole call site omits patientAge so no percentile is ever computed. See CAPA-005.

RC-005.description: Abnormality flags show threshold criteria used
RC-005.note: Thresholds live only in Python comments; flag can never fire. See CAPA-005.

RC-008.description: Edge AI badge displays confidence and assistive-only disclaimer
RC-008.note: Disclaimer gated behind useState(false); renders only after a click. See CAPA-004 CA-4.4.

RC-009.description: Edge AI model admin-supplied; feature hidden when unavailable
RC-009.note: Verified by inspection 2026-07-18 and broader than claimed (also rejects text/html), but not bound to a test. ID conflicts with the withdrawn RCV-SUMMARY. CA-3.

RC-011.note: Displayed and honest, but the control names EDT/Atlas/Geometric while the UI exposes auto/msmask/geometric. Wording cannot be mapped to the screen. CA-3.

RC-012.note: Purely dimensional; a no-op on square 256x256 volumes, the standard brain-MRI matrix. See CAPA-004 CA-4.3.

RC-013.note: No orientation validation on upload. CAPA-004 CA-4.1 has landed the primitives (see RC-023) but they are NOT yet wired into load_nifti_from_bytes — see RC-023's note for why that migration must convert image and mask together. Also outstanding: L/R laterality labels on the viewport (CA-4.2). See CAPA-004.

RC-014.note: Implemented exactly as written — the only control of which that is true — but not bound to a test. CA-3.

RC-015.description: DIS per-region details with qualifying lesion counts
RC-015.note: 3 of 5 McDonald 2024 regions, correctly and honestly disclosed. Counts are returned and typed but rendered by no component. CA-3.

RC-016.description: Patient name and MRN displayed in viewer
RC-016.note: patientName is a dead prop in ImageViewer2D; MRN displayed nowhere. See CAPA-004 CA-4.2.

RC-018.note: Model correct; 7 of 124 routes enforce a permission, 0 enforce a role, 10 of 15 permissions never checked. See CAPA-004 CA-4.5 and CAPA-002.

RC-019.description: DICOM-SEG with standard SOP Class UID
RC-019.note: Code correct. Tests exist but are not RC-named, so the manifest gate cannot bind them yet; the RMF claimed 8 tests and there are 7. CA-3.

RC-020.description: DICOMweb import shows metadata before import
RC-020.note: Source metadata is shown, but the destination is an unvalidated free-text prompt() patient ID with no name confirmation — a mis-association hazard covered by no control. CA-3.

RC-021.description: Report generation timeout (30s) with error message
RC-021.note: No timeout exists anywhere in the report path; no CLAUDE_TIMEOUT setting. Also a synchronous call inside an async handler blocks the worker. CA-3.

RC-023.description: Anatomical orientation is determinable from the affine, and is never guessed when indeterminate
RC-023.negative_control: CAPA-004 CA-4.1 — two vectors: fixed RAS return → 9 failed; canonicalisation neutralised → 2 failed
RC-023.note: NEW control created by CAPA-004 CA-4.1; MUST be added to the Risk Management File §5.1 (tracked). It provides the primitives only. RC-013 — orientation VALIDATION ON UPLOAD — remains not_implemented because canonicalisation is deliberately opt-in: image and mask load through separate calls, so transforming one and not the other would misalign them and create a worse hazard than the one being fixed. Migrating to canonical-by-default must convert both together in one change, with a matched-pair correspondence test.
